description: Free. Returns one episode by id, no wrapper: id, status (generating, then ready), characters, venue, scenes, transcript ([{side, dialogue, action, emotion}]), transcript_total, best_line, and once written: ending, why, box_score. summary, transcript_only or include_transcript: false return less. wait_seconds (up to 30) waits for a date being written instead of polling.

include_transcript.description: false: no lines (ending, box score, transcript_total stay).

since_turn.description: Only lines from this one on (0-based), for polling a date being written.

transcript_only.description: true: just the lines, as "Name: dialogue".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait while it's written (0: answer now; your move wakes it).

name: get_episode
title: Read an episode
